name: Coalition
_comment: Roster of the Long Range Tank mod. tier gates what a factory/engineer of that tier can build; built_by is the build category.

units.name: Commander
units.desc: Command mech. Builds the base. Lose it and you lose the battle.

units.name: Engineer
units.desc: Builds tier 1 structures, assists, repairs and reclaims.

units.name: Scavenger
units.desc: Cannot build. Reclaims wrecks, debris, trees and rocks, or revives wrecks as working units for your side (right-click a wreck, or J and drag a circle).

units.name: Tavria
units.desc: Light armoured carrier. Fast and cheap: takes four land units under thin armour (L load, K unload), proof against rifles and machine guns but not much more. Unarmed.

units.name: Slavuta
units.desc: Amphibious armoured carrier. The Tavria's light hull made watertight: takes six land units (L load, K unload) and drives along the bottom of rivers and lakes up to 4 deep, out of reach of guns, slower there. Unarmed.

units.name: Zaporozhets
units.desc: Infantry fighting vehicle, heavily armoured. Takes eight land units under thick armour (L load, K unload): shrugs off small arms, riot guns and much of an autocannon's fire, and takes several tank shells. A roof machine gun keeps infantry off it. Slow.

units.name: Hetman
units.desc: Heavy infantry fighting vehicle, the Zaporozhets grown up. Takes ten land units under thick armour (L load, K unload), with explosive reactive armor on top: its first four missile hits (AT troopers, Robins) lose three quarters of their damage, and a full repair replaces the tiles. Twin roof machine guns.

units.name: Chaika
units.desc: Patrol boat with twin heavy machine guns that fire at ground and air targets alike. Fast and lightly armored. Sails on deep water only.

units.name: Shtorm
units.desc: Gunboat with a 30 mm autocannon firing bursts at ground and air targets, and its own radar. Well armored. Sails on deep water only.

units.name: Buggy
units.desc: Land scout. Fast, fragile, long sight - the eyes of your guns.

units.name: Trooper
units.desc: Armored assault bot. Cheap plasma gun that also hurts armor.

units.name: AT Trooper
units.desc: Infantry with a guided anti-tank missile and six rounds of it; spent rounds come back one a minute for mass. Slow to reload; best fired from cover or from a building.

units.name: Sniper Trooper
units.desc: Marksman with a long rifle. Slow, accurate shots; also picks off infantry inside buildings from afar without harming the building.

units.name: SAM Trooper
units.desc: Infantry with a shoulder-fired homing anti-air missile and six rounds of it; spent rounds come back one a minute for mass. Aircraft only.

units.name: Recon Drone Operator
units.desc: Infantry with a recon quadcopter that scouts far ahead and locks its camera on enemies; a lost drone is replaced after 40 s. Armed only with a pistol.

units.name: Strike Drone Operator
units.desc: Infantry with a kamikaze quadcopter as strong as an anti-tank missile that flies over obstacles to its target; a new drone is ready 40 s after the last. Armed only with a pistol.

units.name: Recon Drone
units.desc: A Recon Drone Operator's quadcopter. Flies ahead of its operator, its camera locks onto enemies, and it keeps clear of known anti-air. Falls when jammed.

units.name: Strike Drone
units.desc: A Strike Drone Operator's kamikaze quadcopter. Flies over anything in the way and dives into its target with an anti-tank charge. Falls when jammed.

units.name: Overtaker M1
units.desc: Light tank. Quick flanker with a 75 mm gauss cannon.

units.name: Pike Mortar
units.desc: Mobile mortar. High-arc fire over hills, range 25-100. Slow traverse. Fires only standing and stays put 3 s after each shot.

units.name: MBFAG-113
units.desc: Mobile anti-air system. Rotary cannon bursts, long reach against aircraft.

units.name: Hailstorm
units.desc: Mobile flak on the Dragoon chassis. Bursts of airburst shells out to 100 at aircraft, ground units and infantry. Fast-slewing guns.

units.name: Skylance
units.desc: Mobile SAM on the Robin chassis. Its own T2 search radar (needs energy; finds stealth 1 aircraft) guides a heavy homing missile at aircraft out to 130, then it reloads for 10 s.

units.name: UC-01R Radar
units.desc: Mobile T1 radar: finds unstealthed units within 120. Hills block it. Needs energy.

units.name: UC-02R Radar
units.desc: Mobile T2 radar: finds unstealthed units within 180 and stealth 1 units (T2 aircraft) within 110. Hills block it. Costly to run.

units.name: UC-03R Radar
units.desc: Mobile T3 radar: finds unstealthed units within 260, stealth 1 units within 180 and stealth 2 units (T3 aircraft) within 100. Infantry never show on radar. Hills block it. Very costly to run.

units.name: Crony M1
units.desc: Main battle tank. Slow turret, heavy armor, 200 damage at range 80.

units.name: Dragoon ARV
units.desc: Armored recon vehicle. Very fast, long sight, 7-round autocannon bursts.

units.name: Robin
units.desc: Mobile anti-tank. One guided missile every 30 seconds; it kills most tanks.

units.name: Engineer Mk2
units.desc: Builds tier 1-2 structures.

units.name: Bohdana
units.desc: Self-propelled howitzer. Range 60-300. Slow to aim, useless without spotters. Fires only standing and stays put 5 s after each shot.

units.name: Bastion
units.desc: Heavy tank with explosive reactive armor: its first four missile hits (AT troopers, Robins) lose three quarters of their damage, and a full repair replaces the tiles. 220 damage at range 85, slow turret.

units.name: Engineer Mk3
units.desc: Builds every structure.

units.name: Kestrel
units.desc: Air scout. Huge sight radius, unarmed.

units.name: Porter
units.desc: Interceptor. Fixed forward railguns, air targets only.

units.name: Cyclone
units.desc: Heavy air superiority fighter. Railguns for aircraft only. Stealth 2, and its own T3 fire-control radar finds stealthed aircraft within 80 (needs energy).

units.name: Firebrand
units.desc: Attack bomber. Runs over its target, drops a stick of five bombs across it, flies on and comes round for the next pass.

units.name: Harrier FB
units.desc: Fighter-bomber. Fast; railguns for aircraft and a pair of bombs for ground targets.

units.name: Hornet
units.desc: Gunship. Hovers and rakes ground units with riot gun bursts, infantry first.

units.name: Dove
units.desc: Suicide drone. Cheap, slow and fragile: any anti-air swats it down. Flies at its target and dives into it with a heavy mortar round.

units.name: Stork
units.desc: Transport aircraft. Lifts eight land units over cliffs and water (L load, K unload). Unarmed.

units.name: Swift
units.desc: Fast transport plane for airdrops: twice as fast as the Stork and never stops. Unload (K) over a spot or a dragged circle: it flies straight through and the cargo falls spread over it, landing 2-3 s later (a dragged circle also sends infantry into free buildings). Carries eight land units like the Stork (L load: it scoops up units it flies over). Stealth 1: only T2+ radar finds it. Unarmed.

units.name: Delivery Boy
units.desc: Prototype heavy bomber. One enormous bomb, armored airframe.

units.name: Trembita
units.desc: Cruise missile: like a suicide drone, but much faster, with a far heavier warhead and a longer strike reach. Not affected by jammers. Very expensive.

units.name: Mass Pump
units.desc: Extracts mass from a deposit. Upgradeable (U).

units.name: Mass Pump Mk2
units.desc: Triple output, more upkeep. Built by tier 2+ engineers or upgraded from a Mass Pump (U).

units.name: Mass Pump Mk3
units.desc: Maximum extraction, heavy energy upkeep. Built by tier 3 engineers or upgraded from a Mk2 pump.

units.name: Windmill
units.desc: Cheap power: +20 energy.

units.name: Power Plant
units.desc: Reliable power: +120 energy. Explodes when destroyed.

units.name: Solar Field
units.desc: Massive power: +400 energy.

units.name: Energy Storage
units.desc: Stores 5000 energy. Explodes violently.

units.name: Mass Storage
units.desc: Stores 500 mass.

units.name: Land Factory
units.desc: Builds tier 1 land units. Upgrade (U) for higher tiers.

units.name: Land Factory Mk2
units.desc: Builds tier 1-2 land units. Right-click sets the rally point.

units.name: Naval Yard
units.desc: Builds tier 2 warships. Goes on a shore, half on land and half over deep water, however steep the bank. Expensive.

units.name: Land Factory Mk3
units.desc: Builds tier 1-3 land units. Right-click sets the rally point.

units.name: Air Factory
units.desc: Builds tier 1 air units. Upgrade (U) for higher tiers.

units.name: Air Factory Mk2
units.desc: Builds tier 1-2 air units. Right-click sets the rally point.

units.name: Air Factory Mk3
units.desc: Builds tier 1-3 air units. Right-click sets the rally point.

units.name: HMG Turret
units.desc: Point defense. Shreds bots and scouts, bounces off armor.

units.name: Pike-G Gauss Turret
units.desc: Anti-armor emplacement. High-arc fire, range 30-105, very slow traverse.

units.name: Dart Railgun
units.desc: Anti-air turret.

units.name: Faust SAM
units.desc: Long-range SAM site. Its own T2 search radar (needs energy; finds stealth 1 aircraft) guides one heavy homing missile at an aircraft, then it reloads for 12 s.

units.name: Phalanx Railgun Battery
units.desc: Heavy anti-air battery: twin long railguns guided by its own T3 radar (finds stealth 2 aircraft within 120; needs energy).

units.name: Radar Tower
units.desc: T1 radar: finds unstealthed units within 160. Blocked by terrain - build it on high ground. Needs energy. Upgradeable (U).

units.name: Radar Tower Mk2
units.desc: T2 radar: finds unstealthed units within 250 and stealth 1 units (T2 aircraft) within 160. Blocked by terrain. Costly to run. Built by tier 2+ engineers or upgraded from a Radar Tower (U). Its jammer brings down enemy drones within 45 after 2.5 s.

units.name: Radar Tower Mk3
units.desc: T3 radar: finds unstealthed units within 360, stealth 1 units within 250 and stealth 2 units (T3 aircraft) within 150. Infantry never show on radar. Blocked by terrain. Very costly to run. Built by tier 3 engineers or upgraded from a Radar Tower Mk2 (U). Its jammer brings down enemy drones within 70 after 1 s, and it puts out four false radar echoes that wander around it.

units.name: Radar Decoy
units.desc: A false radar echo put out by a Radar Tower Mk3. Enemy radar sees a unit; there is nothing there.

units.name: Satellite Uplink
units.desc: Experimental: links up with a reconnaissance satellite. Every enemy unit shows on radar wherever it is (infantry still hide) and everything around enemy commanders is in sight. Enormously expensive to build and run. Built by tier 3 engineers.

units.name: Engineering Station
units.desc: Automatically assists every construction, upgrade and repair within its radius.

units.name: Bertha Heavy Battery
units.desc: Fortified 120 mm gun. Range 40-200, big blast, traverses at a crawl.
